exposure: 1 year prior to L/D unit closure
Rural labor and delivery (L/D) unit closures
rural labor and delivery unit closures
cohort: 4,065 women in 5 rural areas of North Carolina with L/D unit closures between 2013 and 2017
finding: Rural labor and delivery unit closures in North Carolina disproportionately affected women on Medicaid and demonstrated area-specific variability in impact, potentially masking effects when assessed through statewide or national analyses.
mod_finding: This study found that cesarean delivery rates decreased in two rural areas of North Carolina following the closure of local labor and delivery units, while labor induction rates increased.
